text.ko: 네가 자주 떠올리는 생각이 어떠하든 네 마음도 그러하게 된다. 영혼은 생각에 물들기 때문이다.
text.en: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.

approved.original: Οἷα ἂν πολλάκις φαντασθῇς, τοιαύτη σοι ἔσται ἡ διάνοια· βάπτεται γὰρ ὑπὸ τῶν φαντασιῶν ἡ ψυχή.

text.ko: 사람을 어지럽히는 것은 사물이 아니라, 사물에 대해 갖는 생각이다.
text.en: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.

approved.original: Ταράσσει τοὺς ἀνθρώπους οὐ τὰ πράγματα, ἀλλὰ τὰ περὶ τῶν πραγμάτων δόγματα.

text.ko: 자기 삶의 '왜'를 지닌 사람은 거의 모든 '어떻게'를 견뎌낸다.
text.en: If a man knows the wherefore of his existence, then the manner of it can take care of itself.

approved.original: Hat man sein warum? des Lebens, so verträgt man sich fast mit jedem wie?

text.ko: 너 자신을 믿어라. 모든 심장은 그 쇠줄에 맞추어 울린다.
text.en: Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.

approved.original: Trust thyself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.

text.ko: 성공은 그가 오른 자리가 아니라, 성공하려 애쓰며 넘어선 장애물로 재야 한다.
text.en: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome while trying to succeed.

approved.original: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome while trying to succeed.

text.ko: 사람은 누구나 한 번 죽는다. 그 죽음이 태산보다 무겁기도 하고, 기러기 털보다 가볍기도 하다.
text.en: Every man has but one death. That death may be heavier than Mount Tai, or lighter than a goose feather.

approved.original: 人固有一死，死有重於泰山，或輕於鴻毛

text.ko: 나는 내 운명의 주인이요, 내 영혼의 선장이다.
text.en: I am the master of my fate: I am the captain of my soul.

approved.original: I am the master of my fate: I am the captain of my soul.

text.ko: 마음은 그 자체로 하나의 세계라, 스스로 지옥을 천국으로도 천국을 지옥으로도 만든다.
text.en: The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a Heaven of Hell, a Hell of Heaven.

approved.original: The mind is its own place, and in itself Can make a Heaven of Hell, a Hell of Heaven.

text.ko: 의심은 배신자다. 시도를 두려워하게 만들어, 얻었을 좋은 것을 잃게 한다.
text.en: Our doubts are traitors, and make us lose the good we oft might win by fearing to attempt.

approved.original: Our doubts are traitors, And make us lose the good we oft might win By fearing to attempt.

text.ko: 우리는 모두 시궁창에 있다. 그러나 그중 몇은 별을 바라본다.
text.en: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.

approved.original: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.

text.ko: 그 이름에 값하는 유일한 자유는, 제 방식대로 제 좋음을 좇는 자유다.
text.en: The only freedom which deserves the name, is that of pursuing our own good in our own way.

approved.original: The only freedom which deserves the name, is that of pursuing our own good in our own way.

text.ko: 위대한 일은 힘이 아니라 끈기로 이루어진다.
text.en: Great works are performed not by strength, but perseverance.

approved.original: Great works are performed not by strength, but perseverance.

text.ko: 사람이 닿으려는 곳은 잡히는 곳보다 멀어야 한다. 아니면 하늘은 무엇하러 있겠는가?
text.en: Ah, but a man's reach should exceed his grasp, or what's a heaven for?

approved.original: Ah, but a man's reach should exceed his grasp, Or what's a heaven for?

text.ko: 언젠가 반드시 정상에 올라, 뭇 산이 작음을 한눈에 보리라.
text.en: One day I shall climb to the very summit, and see at a glance how small the mountains are.

approved.original: 會當凌絕頂，一覽衆山小

text.ko: 세 사람이 길을 가면, 그중에 반드시 내 스승이 있다.
text.en: When I walk along with two others, they may serve me as my teachers.

text.ko: 제 배움의 끝을 걱정하지 마라. 일하는 시간마다 성실히 바쁘다면, 마지막 결과는 저절로 되도록 맡겨도 좋다.
text.en: Let no youth have any anxiety about the upshot of his education. If he keep faithfully busy each hour of the working day, he may safely leave the final result to itself.

approved.original: Let no youth have any anxiety about the upshot of his education, whatever the line of it may be. If he keep faithfully busy each hour of the working day, he may safely leave the final result to itself.
